title: THE TITLE SAYS CREATE A NEW SAVE, NOT CREATE A NEW SAVE WITH A CAPITAL A
why: UI step 30, menu map. The no-all-caps door lowers words of 3 or more letters and left the one-letter A alone, so the title button read Create A new save. An A between a word and a caps word now lowers with the line. A sector letter at the end of a line is untouched.
now: The title button now reads Create a new save.
